metrics.tcp_throughput: One application stream, each direction separately,128MiB delivered verified payload. 8MiB warmup each direction outside measurement. Upload is echo-server receiver-ready-to-final-verified-byte monotonic duration, starting immediately after writing readiness R and including readiness/client reaction interval before first read; download is application-client receiver ready-to-final-verified-byte duration. Full byte-for-byte deterministic payload integrity and receiver count required.
metrics.udp_throughput: 16742400B offered payload per direction (16MiB rounded down to436 windows of32x1200B). Fresh UDP flow32 verified64B echo warmups then random64bit transfer ID B/K registration outside throughput interval. Upload offers each32 datagrams then reliable TCP W progress response which does NOT assert all UDP arrived; download reliable TCP D requests each32 UDP writes while receiving concurrently. Final upload Q receipt starts a fixed100ms receiver-local drain; final download D response starts fixed100ms client-local drain. Same receiver mutex orders counter observation/cutoff/final snapshot; observations at/after cutoff excluded. Upload final counters return over reliable TCP Q; download F round-trips exact client receiver snapshot. Actual unique ID+sequence+payload-verified bytes divided by receiver first-data-to-fixed-cutoff duration; zero delivery uses begin-to-cutoff. Includes fixed drain and TCP control/barrier overhead, not raw unpaced UDP capacity. Report actual offered/delivered/lost/duplicate/corrupt counts and loss percentage, zero DATA retransmission; no waiting for all32 datagrams and no assumed zero loss. No discarded warm DATA transfer. Driver controls include reordered same-source consecutive IDs with deliberately missing6,duplicate1,corrupt1,plus zero-delivery accounting.
metrics.established_latency: 256 individual integer Go monotonic time.Since nanosecond samples of actual64B request/64B verified echo RTT on established flow;32 warmup echoes excluded. Preallocated64/65-byte send and64-byte receive buffers exist before each timer starts. Run with no concurrent throughput workload; RTT measured before goodput. UDP echo is64B, TCP application payload64B plus one command byte.
metrics.setup_latency: 8 fresh application dial-through-first-verified64B response samples.32 initial warmup echoes pre-establish proxy/WG state. Includes lazy remote application setup; not SOCKS CONNECT and not cold WG association startup. Separately labeled from established RTT.
metrics.summary: Each round yields one upload and one download goodput, one median of256 established RTT samples, and one median of8 first-response setup samples. Primary absolute result is median of seven matched round measurements, with min/max, Q1/Q3 and MAD. Do not substitute pooled request median for median-of-seven round medians. Decimal MB/s=bytes/ns*1000, Mbit/s=MB/s*8; RTT us/ns1000, ms/ns1000000. Keep all integer raw durations and byte counts.

counterbalance: Each protocol cohort uses the same seven deterministic unique rotations/reversals fixed before its timing, each matched round includes all four candidates once per workload. Seven is not divisible by four, so positions are not perfectly balanced. Workload order rotates by round modulo five. Each protocol is separate, not interleaved; fresh fixed/client/gateway/candidate processes per cell.
sequence_policy: One full fixed sequence only after director authorizes source+plan+all-correctness smoke. No cherry picking, timed retries, retunes, extra candidates, or tuning datasets. Preparation smoke captures the full matrix including failed UDP statuses so reachable TCP coverage is never blocked by an earlier UDP failure; final smoke exits nonzero if any cell fails. Timed sequence stops and retains evidence on its first failed cell, with no retry. Pre-timing correctness repairs preserve all failed smoke evidence separately.
